project.name: CiviTech Global Platform
project.description: Persian-first civic technology platform with an insurance lead generation Telegram bot, an Express/Fastify API, and a React 19 admin/dashboard frontend.

bot.flow: /start → Category → Subcategory → Full Name → Phone → City → Contact Time → Notes → Confirm → Lead Created

domain_model.primary_flow: Telegram bot captures insurance leads (category, subcategory, contact info) which admins manage via /admin/leads in the React web app.

engineering_conventions.middleware: authenticate, authorize, requirePermission, validate, rateLimit, errorHandler
engineering_conventions.frontend_components: components/ui, components/layout, components/three, pages/admin, pages/dashboard, pages/public

quality_gates.docker: docker-compose.yml orchestrates API, bot, web, Postgres

critical_rules: All user input must be validated with Zod before reaching controllers or services.
All database changes require Prisma migrations and seed updates when applicable.
All Persian-facing UI must support RTL, Vazir font, and localized copy from i18n/fa.ts.
Telegram bot copy and keyboards must be Persian-first and use persian-digits utilities.
Authentication uses JWT access tokens + refresh tokens with token versioning and soft-delete aware lookups.
PII (phone numbers, names, Telegram IDs) must be handled with least-privilege and never logged in plain text.
Every code change must pass lint, type-check, and relevant tests before being marked complete.
roadmap_themes: Admin analytics dashboard and conversion tracking
